name: FA_MC_DEPRN_PERIODS
description: FA_MC_DEPRN_PERIODS contains information about your depreciation periods for each reporting book. It is an MRC sub-table of FA_DEPRN_PERIODS.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Asset book depreciation calendar period name.

columns.name: FISCAL_YEAR
columns.description: Name of the accounting fiscal year.

columns.name: PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Period number of depreciation period in the fiscal year.

columns.name: PERIOD_OPEN_DATE
columns.description: System date when the depreciation period was opened.

columns.name: PERIOD_CLOSE_DATE
columns.description: System date when the depreciation period was closed.

columns.name: CALENDAR_PERIOD_OPEN_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the calendar period.

columns.name: CALENDAR_PERIOD_CLOSE_DATE
columns.description: End date of the calendar period.

columns.name: DEPRN_RUN
columns.description: Indicator used to determine whether depreciation has been run for a period.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
